verdict.rationale: Typesense's official guide has dedicated 'Faceting' and 'Filtering results' sections. A community evaluator independently confirms Typesense performs faceted search (in-memory), and another praises its compact filter_by syntax. The evidence is mostly section headings, though, and does not show facet counts, range facets, or multi-attribute faceting returned in one query. Missing for 10: evidence of live facet counts, numeric/range faceting, multiple facet fields in a single query, and in-depth faceting docs or hands-on corroboration of the navigation UX.
